title.narrative: Making the Link From Best Practices to Policy Formulation

description.narrative: The objective of this activity is to inform future policy decisions and improve service delivery to the poor by supporting the Indonesian Government's current efforts to learn lessons and identify best practices from past and ongoing poverty programs. Program Components include: (a) Mapping of ongoing development programs and collecting studies/evaluations, including: categorizing poverty programs, contacting and gathering project documents and information from responsible government ministries, donors and other organizations, and organizing a database of project information; (b) Program development focused specifically on monitoring and evaluation based on the Recipient's ongoing development programs in order to inform new policies and poverty reduction programs, including: developing detailed work plans for development program evaluation and research, commissioning studies and disseminating results thereof; and (c) Building partnerships with Indonesian university networks to develop in-country monitoring and evaluation capacity, including: examining university programs related to community development and research, and assessing the feasibility of a pilot program for partnership with one or more universities for research, monitoring and evaluation of development programs.
